q: 我___经吃过午饭了。
zh: 我已经吃过午饭了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo wǔ fàn le
en: I've already had lunch.
why: 已经 'already' is written with 已, whose left stroke closes halfway. 己 (fully open) is 'self' in 自己, and 巳 (closed) is almost never needed. Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full.

q: 早饭我喝了一杯热___奶。
zh: 早饭我喝了一杯热牛奶。
py: zǎo fàn wǒ hē le yī bēi rè niú nǎi
en: I had a cup of hot milk for breakfast.
why: 牛奶 is cow's milk, and 牛 has its vertical stroke poking through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line: it is noon, as in 下午. 午奶 is not a word.

q: 这个周___我们公司有一场篮球比赛。
zh: 这个周末我们公司有一场篮球比赛。
py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài
en: This weekend our company has a basketball game.
why: 周末 is the end of the week, and 末 has the long line on top, like the tip of a tree. 未 has a short line on top and means 'not yet' (未来), so 周未 is not a word.

q: ___来的手机可能会越来越聪明。
zh: 未来的手机可能会越来越聪明。
py: wèi lái de shǒu jī kě néng huì yuè lái yuè cōng míng
en: Future phones may get smarter and smarter.
why: 未来 'the future' is written with 未: short line on top, longer line below ('not yet'). 末 is the end (周末, 月末), and 末来 is not a word.

q: 请把杯子洗___净。
zh: 请把杯子洗干净。
py: qǐng bǎ bēi zi xǐ gān jìng
en: Please wash the cup clean.
why: 干净 (clean) is written with 干: two flat lines and a straight stroke down. 千 (thousand) starts with a slanting stroke and 于 ends in a hook, so 洗千净 and 洗于净 are not words.

q: 他练了三个月，终___学会了游泳。
zh: 他练了三个月，终于学会了游泳。
py: tā liàn le sān ge yuè zhōng yú xué huì le yóu yǒng
en: After three months of practice, he finally learned to swim.
why: 终于 'finally' ends in 于, whose bottom stroke hooks like a fish hook. 千 and 干 have no hook, so 终千 and 终干 are not words.

q: 这双运动鞋要两___块。
zh: 这双运动鞋要两千块。
py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yào liǎng qiān kuài
en: This pair of sports shoes costs two thousand yuan.
why: 千 (thousand) starts with a slanting stroke on top; 干 starts flat and 于 hooks at the bottom. Only 千 gives 两千块, 'two thousand yuan'.

q: 关___这次足球比赛的新规则，请大家认真看一下通知。
zh: 关于这次足球比赛的新规则，请大家认真看一下通知。
py: guān yú zhè cì zú qiú bǐ sài de xīn guī zé qǐng dà jiā rèn zhēn kàn yī xià tōng zhī
en: Please read the notice carefully about the new rules for this football match.
why: 关于 'about, regarding' ends in 于 with its hooked stroke. 干 and 千 are different characters, so 关干 and 关千 do not exist. Think of a fish hook: 于.

q: 她在医院当护___，每天都很忙。
zh: 她在医院当护士，每天都很忙。
py: tā zài yī yuàn dāng hù shi měi tiān dōu hěn máng
en: She works as a nurse in a hospital and is busy every day.
why: 护士 'nurse' has 士, with the long line on top. 土 (earth) has the long line at the bottom, like the ground. 护土 is not a word.

q: 晚饭我想做___豆炖牛肉。
zh: 晚饭我想做土豆炖牛肉。
py: wǎn fàn wǒ xiǎng zuò tǔ dòu dùn niú ròu
en: For dinner I want to make beef stewed with potatoes.
why: 土豆 'potato' grows in the earth: 土 has the long line at the bottom, like the ground. 士 has it on top, as in 护士. 士豆 is not a word.

q: 他不喜欢点外卖，每天下班回家以后都___做饭。
zh: 他不喜欢点外卖，每天下班回家以后都自己做饭。
py: tā bù xǐ huan diǎn wài mài měi tiān xià bān huí jiā yǐ hòu dōu zì jǐ zuò fàn
en: He doesn't like ordering takeout; every day after work he cooks for himself at home.
why: 自己 'oneself' ends in 己, wide open at the top left. 已 is half closed and belongs in 已经; 自已 and 自巳 are not words. Open 己 for yourself.

s: 会议己经开始了，请大家安静。
s_py: huì yì jǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qǐng dà jiā ān jìng
zh: 会议已经开始了，请大家安静。
py: huì yì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qǐng dà jiā ān jìng
en: The meeting has already started; please be quiet.
why: 已经 'already' needs 已, half closed; 己 is fully open and is 'self' (自己). 己经 is not a word. Remember: 已 is half shut.

s: 冰箱里还有一盒午奶。
s_py: bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu yī hé wǔ nǎi
zh: 冰箱里还有一盒牛奶。
py: bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu yī hé niú nǎi
en: There is still a carton of milk in the fridge.
why: Milk is 牛奶: 牛 has its vertical stroke poking through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line (下午, noon). 午奶 is not a word.

s: 下午我们公司有一个会议。
zh: 下午我们公司有一个会议。
py: xià wǔ wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī ge huì yì
en: We have a meeting at our company this afternoon.
why: Correct: 下午 'afternoon' is written with 午, whose vertical stroke stops at the top line. 牛 pokes through it and means cow. Only the cow's stroke has a horn.

q: 请从这个___口进去，出口在后面。
zh: 请从这个入口进去，出口在后面。
py: qǐng cóng zhè ge rù kǒu jìn qù chū kǒu zài hòu miàn
en: Please go in through this entrance; the exit is at the back.
why: 入口 'entrance' is the opposite of 出口; 入 has its long stroke on the right, like an arrow going in. 人 leans on its left stroke and gives 人口, population; 八 is the number eight.

q: 这件外套___大了，我想换小一点的。
zh: 这件外套太大了，我想换小一点的。
py: zhè jiàn wài tào tài dà le wǒ xiǎng huàn xiǎo yī diǎn de
en: This coat is too big; I'd like to swap it for a smaller one.
why: 太 + adjective + 了 means 'too ...'. 太 is 大 with a dot underneath: a dot of 'too much'. 大大了 and 夫大了 make no sense here.

q: 今___是星期六，我们去打羽毛球。
zh: 今天是星期六，我们去打羽毛球。
py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
en: Today is Saturday; let's go play badminton.
why: 今天 'today' has 天: 大 with a line on top, the sky above a person. 大 (big) and 夫 do not fit, and 今大 is not a word.

q: 她的丈___是一位厨师，做的菜特别好吃。
zh: 她的丈夫是一位厨师，做的菜特别好吃。
py: tā de zhàng fu shì yī wèi chú shī zuò de cài tè bié hǎo chī
en: Her husband is a chef, and the dishes he makes are especially delicious.
why: 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫, whose top slant pokes out above two lines. 大 (big) and 天 (sky) give 丈大 and 丈天, which are not words.

q: 明天是我的生___，我想请朋友吃饭。
zh: 明天是我的生日，我想请朋友吃饭。
py: míng tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì wǒ xiǎng qǐng péng you chī fàn
en: Tomorrow is my birthday and I want to treat my friends to a meal.
why: 生日 'birthday' has 日, the sun or day, with one line inside. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines and 白 has a dot on top; 生目 and 生白 are not words.

q: 老师，这个题___我看不懂，能再说一遍吗？
zh: 老师，这个题目我看不懂，能再说一遍吗？
py: lǎo shī zhè ge tí mù wǒ kàn bù dǒng néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
en: Teacher, I can't understand this question; could you say it again?
why: 题目 'question, title' uses 目, the eye, since it is what you look at: taller, with two lines inside. 日 has one line and 白 a dot on top, so 题日 and 题白 are not words.

q: 你说得太快了，我不明___。
zh: 你说得太快了，我不明白。
py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le wǒ bù míng bai
en: You're speaking too fast; I don't understand.
why: 明白 'understand' ends in 白: 日 with a slanted dot on top, like a bright white light. 日 and 自 are different characters, and 不明日 and 不明自 are not words.

q: 这个城市的___口有两千多万，所以路上总是很挤。
zh: 这个城市的人口有两千多万，所以路上总是很挤。
py: zhè ge chéng shì de rén kǒu yǒu liǎng qiān duō wàn suǒ yǐ lù shang zǒng shì hěn jǐ
en: This city has over twenty million people, so the roads are always crowded.
why: 人口 'population' has 人, which leans on its long left stroke. 入 leans the other way and means 'enter' (入口, entrance), which makes no sense with 两千多万. 八 is the number eight.

q: 我们公司早上___点上班。
zh: 我们公司早上八点上班。
py: wǒ men gōng sī zǎo shang bā diǎn shàng bān
en: Our company starts work at eight in the morning.
why: 八 'eight' has two strokes that do not touch, like legs apart. 人 and 入 have strokes that join at the top, so 人点 and 入点 are not times of day.

q: 我每天用手机写___记，记下有意思的事。
zh: 我每天用手机写日记，记下有意思的事。
py: wǒ měi tiān yòng shǒu jī xiě rì jì jì xià yǒu yì si de shì
en: I write a diary on my phone every day to record interesting things.
why: 日记 'diary' is a record of the days: 日 is the sun or day. 目 (eye) and 白 do not mean 'day', so 目记 and 白记 are not words. 日 is short and wide, 目 tall with two lines.

q: 夏___到了，我们常常去海边游泳。
zh: 夏天到了，我们常常去海边游泳。
py: xià tiān dào le wǒ men cháng cháng qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng
en: Summer has come and we often go swimming at the beach.
why: 夏天 'summer' ends in 天: 大 with a line on top, the sky. 夫 has a slant poking out and 大 has no top line, so 夏夫 and 夏大 are not words.

s: 这件毛衣大贵了，我不买。
s_py: zhè jiàn máo yī dà guì le wǒ bù mǎi
zh: 这件毛衣太贵了，我不买。
py: zhè jiàn máo yī tài guì le wǒ bù mǎi
en: This sweater is too expensive; I won't buy it.
why: 'Too expensive' is 太贵了: 太 is 大 with a dot underneath. 大贵 is not a way to say 'too'. The dot means too much.

s: 她穿了一件目色的衬衫，很好看。
s_py: tā chuān le yī jiàn mù sè de chèn shān hěn hǎo kàn
zh: 她穿了一件白色的衬衫，很好看。
py: tā chuān le yī jiàn bái sè de chèn shān hěn hǎo kàn
en: She wore a white shirt and it looked very nice.
why: 白色 'white' has 白: 日 with a slanted dot on top. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines inside, and 目色 is not a colour word. A dot on the sun makes it white.

s: 他把自己的手机借给了我。
zh: 他把自己的手机借给了我。
py: tā bǎ zì jǐ de shǒu jī jiè gěi le wǒ
en: He lent me his own phone.
why: Correct: 自己 'oneself' is 自 (目 with a dot on top) plus the open 己. It may look like a trap because 已 and 目 are close by, but both parts here are right.

q: 我想___一部新手机，可是钱不够。
zh: 我想买一部新手机，可是钱不够。
py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī bù xīn shǒu jī kě shì qián bú gòu
en: I want to buy a new phone, but I don't have enough money.
why: Not having enough money only stops you buying: 买 mǎi. 卖 (sell) is 买 with 十 on top: 多了就卖, 少了就买. A seller would not need money for the phone.

q: 他在网上___自己不用的旧手机，还赚了五百块。
zh: 他在网上卖自己不用的旧手机，还赚了五百块。
py: tā zài wǎng shàng mài zì jǐ bù yòng de jiù shǒu jī hái zhuàn le wǔ bǎi kuài
en: He sold the old phone he no longer uses online and even made five hundred yuan.
why: Earning 五百块 from a phone he does not use means he sold it: 卖 mài, with the extra 十 on top. 买 would be buying his own unused phone, which cannot earn money.

q: 我的钥匙不见了，我在___它。
zh: 我的钥匙不见了，我在找它。
py: wǒ de yào shi bú jiàn le wǒ zài zhǎo tā
en: My key is missing; I'm looking for it.
why: 'Look for' is 找 zhǎo: the hand 扌 with 戈 beside it. 我 (I) is the same shape with one extra slanting stroke on top. A missing key is something you look for, and 我在我它 means nothing.

q: 现在是七点___，我们该吃晚饭了。
zh: 现在是七点半，我们该吃晚饭了。
py: xiàn zài shì qī diǎn bàn wǒ men gāi chī wǎn fàn le
en: It's half past seven; time for dinner.
why: 'Half past' is 半 bàn, with two dots on top, like two halves. 牛 (cow) has one slanted stroke, and 七点牛 is not a time.

q: 足球比赛的上___场，我们一直在输球。
zh: 足球比赛的上半场，我们一直在输球。
py: zú qiú bǐ sài de shàng bàn chǎng wǒ men yī zhí zài shū qiú
en: In the first half of the football match we were losing all the time.
why: 上半场 is the first half of a match: 半 'half' has two dots on top. 牛 has one slanted stroke, so 上牛场 is not a word. Two dots, two halves.

q: 他每天练习跑步，非常努___。
zh: 他每天练习跑步，非常努力。
py: tā měi tiān liàn xí pǎo bù fēi cháng nǔ lì
en: He practises running every day and works very hard.
why: 努力 'work hard' ends in 力, whose slanted stroke pokes up above the top line like a strong arm. 刀 (knife) does not poke through; 努刀 is not a word.

q: 我用水果___切苹果。
zh: 我用水果刀切苹果。
py: wǒ yòng shuǐ guǒ dāo qiē píng guǒ
en: I cut the apple with a fruit knife.
why: A fruit knife is 水果刀: 刀 is a blade whose stroke does not poke above the top line. 力 (strength) pokes above it. 水果力 is not an object you cut with.

q: 树上有一只小___在唱歌。
zh: 树上有一只小鸟在唱歌。
py: shù shang yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo zài chàng gē
en: There is a little bird singing in the tree.
why: A singing bird is 鸟 niǎo, with a dot for its eye. 乌 (crow, black) has no eye dot, because you cannot see a black crow's eye; 小乌 is not the word for a little bird.

q: 天上有一大片___云，可能要下大雨了。
zh: 天上有一大片乌云，可能要下大雨了。
py: tiān shang yǒu yī dà piàn wū yún kě néng yào xià dà yǔ le
en: There is a big patch of dark clouds in the sky; it may pour soon.
why: 乌云 'dark clouds' uses 乌, the black crow with no eye dot. 鸟 has the dot and means bird, so 鸟云 is not a word. Dark clouds, no dot.

q: 晚安，我们明天再___。
zh: 晚安，我们明天再见。
py: wǎn ān wǒ men míng tiān zài jiàn
en: Good night, see you again tomorrow.
why: 再见 'see you' ends in 见, whose last stroke is a hooked foot. 贝 (shell) ends in a dot, and 再贝 is not a word.

q: 他的表演精彩得___人难忘，大家都站起来鼓掌。
zh: 他的表演精彩得令人难忘，大家都站起来鼓掌。
py: tā de biǎo yǎn jīng cǎi de lìng rén nán wàng dà jiā dōu zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng
en: His performance was so brilliant it was unforgettable, and everyone stood up to applaud.
why: 令人 'makes people (feel)' is written 令, which ends in a dot over a vertical, like 卩. 今 (now, as in 今天) ends like a 7. 今人难忘 does not mean 'unforgettable'.

s: 我们在网上卖了一双球鞋，明天就能穿了。
s_py: wǒ men zài wǎng shàng mài le yī shuāng qiú xié míng tiān jiù néng chuān le
zh: 我们在网上买了一双球鞋，明天就能穿了。
py: wǒ men zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié míng tiān jiù néng chuān le
en: We bought a pair of sports shoes online and can wear them tomorrow.
why: Shoes you can wear tomorrow were bought: 买, with no 十 on top. 卖 means sell, so the sentence would say you sold the shoes, which cannot lead to wearing them.

s: 我的耳机不见了，你能帮我我一下吗？
s_py: wǒ de ěr jī bú jiàn le nǐ néng bāng wǒ wǒ yī xià ma
zh: 我的耳机不见了，你能帮我找一下吗？
py: wǒ de ěr jī bú jiàn le nǐ néng bāng wǒ zhǎo yī xià ma
en: My earphones are missing; can you help me look for them?
why: 'Help me look' is 帮我找一下: 找 has the hand radical 扌 and no slanting stroke on top. 我一下 repeats 'I' and means nothing.

s: 今天的天气不错，我们去公园放风筝吧。
zh: 今天的天气不错，我们去公园放风筝吧。
py: jīn tiān de tiān qì bù cuò wǒ men qù gōng yuán fàng fēng zheng ba
en: The weather is nice today; let's go fly a kite in the park.
why: Correct: 今天 'today' is written with 今, which ends like a 7. 令 ends in 卩 and belongs in 令人. Only 今 makes 今天.

q: ___问，地铁站怎么走？
zh: 请问，地铁站怎么走？
py: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zěn me zǒu
en: Excuse me, how do I get to the subway station?
why: 请问 'may I ask' is polite speech, so it has the speech radical 讠: 请. 清 has water 氵 and 情 a heart 忄; 清问 and 情问 are not words.

q: 今天是___天，我们去爬山吧。
zh: 今天是晴天，我们去爬山吧。
py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù pá shān ba
en: Today is a sunny day; let's go hiking.
why: Weather is about the sun, so 晴天 'sunny day' has 日: 晴. 清 (water) and 睛 (eye) share the part 青 but have the wrong meaning; 清天 and 睛天 are not words.

q: 我的小猫有一双大大的眼___。
zh: 我的小猫有一双大大的眼睛。
py: wǒ de xiǎo māo yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing
en: My kitten has a pair of big eyes.
why: 眼睛 'eyes' has the eye radical 目: 睛. 晴 has the sun and is for weather, so 眼晴 is the classic typo. Eyes take 目, sunshine takes 日.

q: 这个视频的声音不___楚，我听不懂。
zh: 这个视频的声音不清楚，我听不懂。
py: zhè ge shì pín de shēng yīn bù qīng chu wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: The sound in this video isn't clear, and I can't understand it.
why: 清楚 'clear' has water 氵, like clear water: 清. 请 (speech) and 情 (heart) have the wrong meaning; 不请楚 and 不情楚 are not words.

q: 比赛赢了以后，大家的心___都特别好。
zh: 比赛赢了以后，大家的心情都特别好。
py: bǐ sài yíng le yǐ hòu dà jiā de xīn qíng dōu tè bié hǎo
en: After winning the match, everyone was in an especially good mood.
why: 心情 'mood' is about the heart, so it takes 忄: 情. 晴 (sun) sounds the same but 心晴 is not the word for mood, and 请 is speech. Feelings take the heart.

q: 昨天的足球赛太___彩了，我一直看到最后。
zh: 昨天的足球赛太精彩了，我一直看到最后。
py: zuó tiān de zú qiú sài tài jīng cǎi le wǒ yī zhí kàn dào zuì hòu
en: Yesterday's football match was so brilliant that I watched until the end.
why: 精彩 'brilliant' has rice 米 on the left (refined grain, the best part): 精. 请 has speech 讠 and 清 water 氵; 请彩 and 清彩 are not words. Brilliant = refined rice.

q: 我想___你吃晚饭，你有空吗？
zh: 我想请你吃晚饭，你有空吗？
py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī wǎn fàn nǐ yǒu kòng ma
en: I'd like to invite you to dinner; are you free?
why: 'Invite, treat' is 请: the speech radical 讠, because you ask someone. 清 has water and means clear, so 清你吃饭 makes no sense.

q: 我___在三楼，办公室在二楼。
zh: 我住在三楼，办公室在二楼。
py: wǒ zhù zài sān lóu bàn gōng shì zài èr lóu
en: I live on the third floor and the office is on the second.
why: 'Live (somewhere)' is 住: a person 亻 plus 主, since a person lives somewhere. 往 (彳, two slanted strokes) means toward and 注 (氵) means pour, so 往在 and 注在 do not work.

q: 出了地铁站，___右拐就是我们公司。
zh: 出了地铁站，往右拐就是我们公司。
py: chū le dì tiě zhàn wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì wǒ men gōng sī
en: Come out of the subway station and turn right; our company is right there.
why: 'Toward' is 往: the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes) is for going. 住 has a single 亻 and means live, so 住右拐 is not a direction.

q: 开车的时候要___意安全，不要看手机。
zh: 开车的时候要注意安全，不要看手机。
py: kāi chē de shí hou yào zhù yì ān quán bù yào kàn shǒu jī
en: When you drive, pay attention to safety and don't look at your phone.
why: 注意 'pay attention' has water 氵: 注, as if attention is poured onto something. 住 (亻) means live and 往 means toward, so 住意 and 往意 are not words.

q: 我的___要工作是接电话和写报告。
zh: 我的主要工作是接电话和写报告。
py: wǒ de zhǔ yào gōng zuò shì jiē diàn huà hé xiě bào gào
en: My main jobs are answering the phone and writing reports.
why: 主要 'main' is written with 主 alone, with no radical beside it. 住 and 注 add one, so 住要 and 注要 are not words.

s: 她的眼晴红红的，好像哭过。
s_py: tā de yǎn qíng hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng kū guo
zh: 她的眼睛红红的，好像哭过。
py: tā de yǎn jing hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng kū guo
en: Her eyes are red; she seems to have been crying.
why: Eyes are 眼睛, with the eye radical 目. 晴 has the sun and is for weather, so 眼晴 is the classic typo. Eye for eyes, sun for sunny.

s: 一直住前走，你会看到一家咖啡店。
s_py: yī zhí zhù qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yī jiā kā fēi diàn
zh: 一直往前走，你会看到一家咖啡店。
py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yī jiā kā fēi diàn
en: Keep going straight and you'll see a coffee shop.
why: 'Toward' is 往, with the step radical 彳 for movement. 住 has a single 亻 and means live, so 住前走 is not a direction.

s: 明天会是个晴天，适合出去跑步。
zh: 明天会是个晴天，适合出去跑步。
py: míng tiān huì shì ge qíng tiān shì hé chū qù pǎo bù
en: Tomorrow will be a sunny day, good for going out for a run.
why: Correct: 晴天 has the sun 日, because it is about weather. It may look like a trap next to 睛 and 清, but sunshine is 日, so 晴 is right.

q: 我姐姐喜欢游泳，___每天都去游泳池。
zh: 我姐姐喜欢游泳，她每天都去游泳池。
py: wǒ jiě jie xǐ huan yóu yǒng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng chí
en: My older sister likes swimming; she goes to the pool every day.
why: A woman is 她, with the woman radical 女; here it is my sister. 他 is for a man and 它 for things and animals. All three sound tā, so the meaning decides.

q: 我的新手机不见了，你看见___了吗？
zh: 我的新手机不见了，你看见它了吗？
py: wǒ de xīn shǒu jī bú jiàn le nǐ kàn jiàn tā le ma
en: My new phone is missing; have you seen it?
why: A thing is 它, with a roof 宀 over a small 匕: neither he nor she. 他 is a man and 她 a woman, and a phone is not a person. All three sound tā.

q: 周末我们常去学校的游泳___游泳。
zh: 周末我们常去学校的游泳池游泳。
py: zhōu mò wǒ men cháng qù xué xiào de yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng
en: At weekends we often go swimming at the school pool.
why: 游泳池 'swimming pool' has water 氵: 池. 地 (ground) has earth 土 and 他 is a person, so 游泳地 and 游泳他 are not words. A pool holds water.

q: 你是___国人？
zh: 你是哪国人？
py: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén
en: Which country are you from?
why: 'Which' is 哪 nǎ: 那 with an asking mouth 口 added. 那 (nà, that) only points to something, so 你是那国人 is the classic typo.

q: 我要的是___个蓝色的包，不是这个。
zh: 我要的是那个蓝色的包，不是这个。
py: wǒ yào de shì nà ge lán sè de bāo bú shì zhè ge
en: I want that blue bag, not this one.
why: 'That one' set against 这个 is 那 nà, with no mouth: it only points. 哪 (nǎ, which) asks a question, and 我要的是哪个 would be a question, not a statement.

q: 请问，游泳馆在___儿？
zh: 请问，游泳馆在哪儿？
py: qǐng wèn yóu yǒng guǎn zài nǎ r
en: Excuse me, where is the swimming pool?
why: 'Where' is 哪儿 nǎr: 哪 has the asking mouth 口. 那儿 means 'over there', which cannot be the word in a question that asks where the pool is.

q: 我周末常___朋友一起打羽毛球。
zh: 我周末常跟朋友一起打羽毛球。
py: wǒ zhōu mò cháng gēn péng you yī qǐ dǎ yǔ máo qiú
en: At weekends I often play badminton with friends.
why: 'Together with' is 跟 gēn, with the foot radical 足: following along. 根 (root, wood 木) sounds the same but cannot mean 'with', and 很 means very.

q: 这家餐厅的菜___好吃，我们常来。
zh: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃，我们常来。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài hěn hǎo chī wǒ men cháng lái
en: The food at this restaurant is very tasty, and we come often.
why: 'Very' before an adjective is 很 hěn, with the step radical 彳. 狠 (animal 犭) means ruthless and 根 is a root; neither can mean 'very' before 好吃.

q: 这件衬衫五十___钱，不贵。
zh: 这件衬衫五十块钱，不贵。
py: zhè jiàn chèn shān wǔ shí kuài qián bú guì
en: This shirt is fifty yuan; that's not expensive.
why: 'Yuan' in speech is 块 kuài, with earth 土 (a lump). 快 (heart 忄, fast) and 筷 (bamboo ⺮) sound the same, but 五十快钱 and 五十筷钱 are wrong.

q: 吃面条我习惯用___子，不用叉子。
zh: 吃面条我习惯用筷子，不用叉子。
py: chī miàn tiáo wǒ xí guàn yòng kuài zi bù yòng chā zi
en: When eating noodles I use chopsticks, not a fork.
why: 筷子 'chopsticks' are made of bamboo, so 筷 has the bamboo top ⺮. 快 (heart, fast) and 块 (earth, lump) sound the same, but neither can mean chopsticks.

q: 他穿了一件___色的运动服，很好看。
zh: 他穿了一件蓝色的运动服，很好看。
py: tā chuān le yī jiàn lán sè de yùn dòng fú hěn hǎo kàn
en: He wore a blue sports suit that looked good.
why: 'Blue' is 蓝: grass ⺾ on top, because blue dye came from a plant. 篮 has bamboo ⺮ on top, for a basket woven from bamboo, so 篮色 is not a colour.

s: 运动完了，他渴了一大杯水。
s_py: yùn dòng wán le tā kě le yī dà bēi shuǐ
zh: 运动完了，他喝了一大杯水。
py: yùn dòng wán le tā hē le yī dà bēi shuǐ
en: After exercising, he drank a big glass of water.
why: Drinking is done with the mouth: 喝 has 口. 渴 has water 氵 and means thirsty, so 渴了一大杯水 is wrong. Mouth drinks, water is thirst.

s: 我们在体育馆打蓝球。
s_py: wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
zh: 我们在体育馆打篮球。
py: wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
en: We play basketball in the gym.
why: 篮球 'basketball' is named after the basket, woven from bamboo, so 篮 has bamboo ⺮ on top. 蓝 has grass ⺾ and means blue; 打蓝球 would be a blue ball.

s: 我家的猫很懒，它一天要睡十几个小时。
zh: 我家的猫很懒，它一天要睡十几个小时。
py: wǒ jiā de māo hěn lǎn tā yī tiān yào shuì shí jǐ ge xiǎo shí
en: Our cat is lazy and sleeps over ten hours a day.
why: Correct: an animal is written 它, not 他 or 她. It may look like a trap because a pet feels like family, but 它 is the standard written form for an animal.

q: 老师，我可以问你一个___题吗？
zh: 老师，我可以问你一个问题吗？
py: lǎo shī wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī ge wèn tí ma
en: Teacher, may I ask you a question?
why: 问题 'question' starts with 问: a mouth 口 in the door, asking. 间 (sun) and 闻 (ear) give 间题 and 闻题, which are not words. A mouth at the door asks.

q: 你明天有时___吗？我想请你帮个忙。
zh: 你明天有时间吗？我想请你帮个忙。
py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng
en: Do you have time tomorrow? I'd like to ask a favour.
why: 时间 'time' ends in 间: sunlight 日 through a door gap, a stretch of time. 问 has a mouth and 闻 an ear, so 时问 and 时闻 are not words.

q: 爸爸每天晚上都看新___。
zh: 爸爸每天晚上都看新闻。
py: bà ba měi tiān wǎn shang dōu kàn xīn wén
en: Dad watches the news every evening.
why: 新闻 'news' has 闻: an ear 耳 at the door, because news is what you hear. 问 (mouth) and 间 (sun) give 新问 and 新间, which are not words.

q: 你工作了一天，快回家___息吧。
zh: 你工作了一天，快回家休息吧。
py: nǐ gōng zuò le yī tiān kuài huí jiā xiū xi ba
en: You've worked all day; hurry home and rest.
why: 休息 'rest' is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 has the extra line of 本 and means body, so 体息 is the classic typo. Person plus tree is rest.

q: 祝你生日快___！
zh: 祝你生日快乐！
py: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
en: Happy birthday!
why: 快乐 'happy' ends in 乐, which starts with a slanting stroke. 东 starts with a flat line and 车 has no feet; 快东 is not a word and 快车 is an express train, not a birthday wish.

q: 我很___我的小狗，每天都陪它玩。
zh: 我很爱我的小狗，每天都陪它玩。
py: wǒ hěn ài wǒ de xiǎo gǒu měi tiān dōu péi tā wán
en: I love my little dog and play with it every day.
why: 爱 'love' has 友 (friend) at the bottom, under a roof. 受 has only 又 at the bottom and means to receive or bear; 我很受我的小狗 makes no sense. Love needs a friend.

q: 爸爸吃饭的时候喜欢喝一点___。
zh: 爸爸吃饭的时候喜欢喝一点酒。
py: bà ba chī fàn de shí hou xǐ huan hē yī diǎn jiǔ
en: Dad likes to have a little alcohol with his meal.
why: 酒 'alcohol' has 酉, a wine jar with an extra line inside, beside water 氵. 洒 (sprinkle) has only 西. You drink 酒, so 喝洒 is a typo.

q: 看完那个电影，她流下了眼___。
zh: 看完那个电影，她流下了眼泪。
py: kàn wán nà ge diàn yǐng tā liú xià le yǎn lèi
en: After watching that film, she shed tears.
why: 眼泪 'tears' is water 氵 from the eye 目: 泪. 汨 has 日 (sun), is read mì, and appears only in a river name. Water plus eye makes tears.

q: 跑了十公里，我的腿很难___。
zh: 跑了十公里，我的腿很难受。
py: pǎo le shí gōng lǐ wǒ de tuǐ hěn nán shòu
en: After running ten kilometres, my legs feel terrible.
why: 难受 'feel awful' has 受, with only 又 at the bottom. 爱 has 友 there, and 难爱 is not a word. 爱 (love) needs a friend 友; 受 does not.

q: 我在超市买了很多___西。
zh: 我在超市买了很多东西。
py: wǒ zài chāo shì mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi
en: I bought a lot of things at the supermarket.
why: 东西 'things' starts with 东: a flat top line, then a body with two small feet. 乐 starts with a slanting stroke and 车 has no feet; 乐西 and 车西 are not words.

q: 多吃水果对身体有好___。
zh: 多吃水果对身体有好处。
py: duō chī shuǐ guǒ duì shēn tǐ yǒu hǎo chù
en: Eating more fruit is good for your body.
why: 好处 'benefit' has 处: its top-left is 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜. 外 starts with 夕 (evening). 好外 is not a word.

s: 忙了一天，大家都想早点回家体息。
s_py: máng le yī tiān dà jiā dōu xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā tǐ xi
zh: 忙了一天，大家都想早点回家休息。
py: máng le yī tiān dà jiā dōu xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā xiū xi
en: After a busy day, everyone wants to go home early and rest.
why: 休息 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 has the extra line of 本 and means body, so 体息 is the classic typo.

s: 我们坐汽东去公园吧。
s_py: wǒ men zuò qì dōng qù gōng yuán ba
zh: 我们坐汽车去公园吧。
py: wǒ men zuò qì chē qù gōng yuán ba
en: Let's take the car to the park.
why: 汽车 'car' ends in 车: no feet, and a line at the bottom. 东 has a flat top line and two small feet and means east; 汽东 is not a word.

s: 窗外的雨下得很大，我们别出去了。
zh: 窗外的雨下得很大，我们别出去了。
py: chuāng wài de yǔ xià de hěn dà wǒ men bié chū qù le
en: It's raining hard outside the window; let's not go out.
why: Correct: 外 'outside' starts with 夕 (evening) then 卜. 处 starts with 夂, whose sweep runs under 卜. 窗外 is right: outside the window.

q: 他每天早上去公园锻___身体。
zh: 他每天早上去公园锻炼身体。
py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang qù gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
en: He works out in the park every morning.
why: 锻炼 'exercise' has fire 火: 炼, from forging metal in a fire. 练 has silk 纟 and belongs in 练习 (practise); 锻练 is the classic typo.

q: 他每天___习弹吉他，进步很快。
zh: 他每天练习弹吉他，进步很快。
py: tā měi tiān liàn xí tán jí tā jìn bù hěn kuài
en: He practises the guitar every day and is improving fast.
why: 练习 'practise' has silk 纟: 练, like working a thread over and over. 炼 has fire 火 and is for 锻炼, working out; 炼习 is not a word.

q: 这家公司的新产品很___害，一个月就卖了十万个。
zh: 这家公司的新产品很厉害，一个月就卖了十万个。
py: zhè jiā gōng sī de xīn chǎn pǐn hěn lì hai yī ge yuè jiù mài le shí wàn ge
en: This company's new product is impressive; it sold a hundred thousand in a month.
why: 厉害 'impressive, fierce' is written 厉, with 万 inside the 厂 cover. 历 has 力 inside 厂 and is for 历史; 历害 is the common typo.

q: 我喜欢看___史书，也喜欢去博物馆参观。
zh: 我喜欢看历史书，也喜欢去博物馆参观。
py: wǒ xǐ huan kàn lì shǐ shū yě xǐ huan qù bó wù guǎn cān guān
en: I like reading history books and visiting museums.
why: 历史 'history' is written 历, with 力 inside 厂. 厉 has 万 and belongs in 厉害; 厉史 is not a word. Remember: 力 inside, 历 history.

q: 你什么时___有空？
zh: 你什么时候有空？
py: nǐ shén me shí hou yǒu kòng
en: When are you free?
why: 时候 'time, when' has 候: after 亻 comes a short vertical stroke, then 矢. 侯 (hóu, a surname) lacks that stroke, so 时侯 is the classic typo.

q: 两个学生在课堂上___论了很久，最后老师也加入了。
zh: 两个学生在课堂上辩论了很久，最后老师也加入了。
py: liǎng ge xué sheng zài kè táng shàng biàn lùn le hěn jiǔ zuì hòu lǎo shī yě jiā rù le
en: Two students debated for a long time in class, and in the end the teacher joined in.
why: 辩论 'debate' is speech, so it has 讠 in the middle: 辩. 辨 has a knife-like stroke and means tell apart; 辫 has silk 纟 for braids. 辨论 and 辫论 are not words.

q: 这两种蓝色太像了，我分___不出来哪个更深。
zh: 这两种蓝色太像了，我分辨不出来哪个更深。
py: zhè liǎng zhǒng lán sè tài xiàng le wǒ fēn biàn bù chū lái nǎ ge gèng shēn
en: These two blues are so alike that I can't tell which is darker.
why: 分辨 'tell apart' has 辨, with a knife-like stroke between the two dots, as if cutting things apart. 辩 is speech (辩论) and 辫 is silk (辫子); 分辫 is not a word.

q: 我想给妈妈___个电话，告诉她我到了。
zh: 我想给妈妈拨个电话，告诉她我到了。
py: wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma bō ge diàn huà gào su tā wǒ dào le
en: I want to call Mum to tell her I've arrived.
why: 拨电话 'dial' is 拨 bō, with 发 on the right (as in 发短信, send a message). 拔 bá is for pulling out, like a tooth, and 拔电话 makes no sense.

q: 他牙疼了三天，今天要去医院___牙。
zh: 他牙疼了三天，今天要去医院拔牙。
py: tā yá téng le sān tiān jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn bá yá
en: His tooth has hurt for three days, so today he is going to the hospital to have it pulled.
why: 拔牙 'pull a tooth' uses 拔 bá: hand 扌 plus 犮, the pulling action. 拨 (bō) is to dial or push aside, so 拨牙 does not make sense.

s: 她梳了一条长长的辫子，看起来很可爱。
zh: 她梳了一条长长的辫子，看起来很可爱。
py: tā shū le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi kàn qǐ lái hěn kě ài
en: She wore her hair in a long braid and looked very cute.
why: Correct: 辫子 'braid' has silk 纟 in the middle, since a braid is twisted like thread. It may look like a trap next to 辩 and 辨, but 辫 is the one with 纟.

q: 开会以前，我们___先把报告发给大家。
zh: 开会以前，我们必须先把报告发给大家。
py: kāi huì yǐ qián wǒ men bì xū xiān bǎ bào gào fā gěi dà jiā
en: Before the meeting, we must first send the report to everyone.
why: 'Must' before a verb is 必须: 须 has the hair 彡 and head 页. 必需 (bìxū, 'indispensable') has rain 雨 on top and is used as 必需品, not before a verb like 先发.

q: 运动了一个小时，我渴了，___要一杯水。
zh: 运动了一个小时，我渴了，需要一杯水。
py: yùn dòng le yī ge xiǎo shí wǒ kě le xū yào yī bēi shuǐ
en: After exercising for an hour I was thirsty and needed a glass of water.
why: 需要 'need' has rain 雨 on top: 需. 须 (hair 彡, head 页) is for 必须 'must' before a verb, and it cannot take a noun like 一杯水 as 'need'.

q: 我给他发了三次消息，他___一次也没有回我。
zh: 我给他发了三次消息，他竟然一次也没有回我。
py: wǒ gěi tā fā le sān cì xiāo xi tā jìng rán yī cì yě méi yǒu huí wǒ
en: I sent him three messages and he actually didn't reply to any.
why: 竟然 'unexpectedly' has 竟, with 音 (a sound) over 儿. 竞 (jìng, compete) has 立 over 兄, so 竞然 is the classic typo.

q: 两家手机公司在市场上的___争非常激烈。
zh: 两家手机公司在市场上的竞争非常激烈。
py: liǎng jiā shǒu jī gōng sī zài shì chǎng shàng de jìng zhēng fēi cháng jī liè
en: The competition between the two phone companies in the market is fierce.
why: 竞争 'compete' has 竞: 立 (stand) over 兄 (older brother), two people standing up to each other. 竟 has 音 over 儿 and belongs in 竟然; 竟争 is the classic typo.

q: 她长得很___她妈妈，大家都这么说。
zh: 她长得很像她妈妈，大家都这么说。
py: tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā mā ma dà jiā dōu zhè me shuō
en: She looks a lot like her mother; everyone says so.
why: 'Resemble' is 像: a person 亻 plus 象, since a likeness is of a person. 象 alone is the elephant and 向 means toward, so 很象 and 很向 do not mean 'look like'.

s: 这家餐厅给我留下了很好的印象。
zh: 这家餐厅给我留下了很好的印象。
py: zhè jiā cān tīng gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn hǎo de yìn xiàng
en: This restaurant left me with a very good impression.
why: Correct: 印象 'impression' is written 象 (the elephant), not 像. It may look like a trap because 像 sounds the same, but 像 is for 'resemble' (好像), and 印象 and 现象 take 象.
